title: 1.4 Applications in Biotechnology
description: Genetic engineering, DNA techniques and the industrial and medical uses of biology. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is Biotechnology?
options: The use of microorganisms to remove pollutants from the environment
An organism that carries a gene introduced from another species
Microbial metabolism used to produce foods and industrial chemicals
The use of biological systems to develop products and processes
questions.correctAnswer: The use of biological systems to develop products and processes
